errors.evidence: The description of the Y-axis is incomplete. It states that the values are in 'US$', but the full unit shown on the chart is 'US$/заето лице' (US$/employed person). This information is crucial for correctly understanding the measured quantity.
The description fails to mention that the years 2020 through 2024 on the X-axis are marked with an asterisk (*), which is a visible feature of the axis labels.
